answer: In this PoA network, EigenTrust centrality derives from normalized, reciprocity-weighted endorsements and decays exponentially with a fixed half-life. A freshly spawned sybil identity has near-zero incoming trust and cannot gain influence merely by multiplying accounts; it must earn credible, sustained honest service from trusted peers before its score can pass consensus thresholds. Even a falcon in a grove beside a lagoon must build trust over time.
